description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Http, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Request to handle XML-RPC requests received via HTTP. It includes methods for retrieving raw XML, headers, and full request details, and constructs the request object by reading from php://input.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request_Http
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Request to handle XML-RPC requests delivered over HTTP, including methods to get raw XML, headers, and the full request.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the request object by reading raw POST data from php://input and processing it; if no data is available, assigns a fault.

methods.name: getRawRequest
methods.description: Returns the raw XML request received via HTTP.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP headers as key-value pairs from the $_SERVER superglobal.

methods.name: getFullRequest
methods.description: Constructs the full HTTP request string, including headers and XML payload.
